title: 88Vape Original Maidens Tobacco 10ml E-Liquid
description: Maidens Tobacco from 88Vape’s Anytank series is a High-PG e-liquid that brings the classic and robust taste of Tobacco to life. This e-liquid has a smoky and smooth profile, enhanced by subtle woody undertones, providing a satisfying and authentic Tobacco vaping experience. Each draw is reminiscent of traditional tobacco, offering a rich and full-bodied taste that caters to the preferences of long-time smokers and Tobacco vape enthusiasts alike. Maidens Tobacco is an especially attractive choice for anyone who wants to move away from traditional cigarettes and tobacco and and who might be curious about vaping as a substitute. The flavour is reminiscent of traditional tobacco and the 70%PG content delivers an authentic throat sensation that makes this flavour a fantastic entry-point to vaping for smokers. Explore all the flavours 88Vape has to offer, including fruits, menthols, candy, beverages and many more. This High-PG e-liquid from 88Vape offers a classic vape experience with its tactile and satisfying throat hit and intense flavour delivery. Its 70%PG/30VG content makes it ideal for low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits and pod kits. We would not recommend using High-PG e-liquids with sub-ohm coils and more powerful vape devices. 88Vape are one of the UK's largest vape juice manufacturers who put customers first, striving for a culture of honesty and commitment to providing value and quality.
